description: Read 567politics selected party/faction positions and independently sourced politician placements in a supported electoral system. Use the country slug from search_politics. Includes source dates, axes, caveats, chartAvailable and articleMarkdown. Closed dictatorships have profiles/context only. For relevant articles, use the returned articleMarkdown URL alone in a paragraph to insert the interactive chart. Coordinates are editorial estimates, not measured ideology or popularity; null is unknown, not center.
name: get_political_spectrum
title: Read a country political spectrum
